svg.text: cols = driven low 1 at a time
beep it out with a meter
Keypad R1 R2 R3 R4 → D12 D11 D8 D7 (PA6 PA7 PA9 PA8)
Keypad C1 C2 C3 → D6 D5 D4 (PB10 PB4 PB5)
GND → rail → encoder GND, both LED −
D15 (PB8) → 100Ω → blue LED (needs ~3V, so less R)
Keypad rows + encoder SW use internal pull-ups (the KY-040
only has pull-ups on CLK and DT). Encoder runs on 3V3 so
nothing ever goes above 3.3V. Skipped: D0/D1 (USART2 console),
D3 (PB3 = SWO for Keil trace), D13 (PA5 = LD2).
Past it → red LED (back on it → blue)
Part II scope: CH1 → CLK (A0), CH2 → DT (A1), ground clip → GND
Read DT right after every CLK edge:
DT ≠ CLK → CW, DT = CLK → CCW
Optional: 10nF from CLK and DT to GND if the scope
shows contact bounce spikes. Not required.
EGR326 Lab 4 — 12-key keypad + KY-040 rotary encoder + blue/red LEDs on NUCLEO-F446RE
